posts.zh:
dsh-dynamic-wallpaper 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。动态壁纸插件：8 种内置 Canvas 壁纸（粒子、流星雨、星际穿梭、波光、雨幕、气泡、字符雨、极光）加自定义视频背景，支持速度/密度/遮罩/模糊调节，配置持久化。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7b9aec3313a05538364b.html
posts.en:
dsh-dynamic-wallpaper is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Animated wallpaper plugin with 8 canvas backgrounds (particles, meteors, starfield, waves, rain, bubbles, matrix, aurora) plus custom video import, and speed/density/opacity/blur sliders with localStorage persistence.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7b9aec3313a05538364b.html
